name: The Last Dragon
source:
The last dragon has perished. What will happen to the world now?

Join the young knight, Alvin, and the princess, Natalia, as they go on a journey filled with action, intrigue, and loss.

[From [url=https://hayamo.itch.io/the-last-dragon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
最后一条龙已经死去。这个世界将会如何？

加入年轻骑士艾尔文与公主娜塔莉娅，和他们一起踏上充满冒险、阴谋与失落的旅程。[引自[url=https://hayamo.itch.io/the-last-dragon]Itch.io[/url]]
